summary: Build board-ready writing, sharper recommendations, and stronger governance papers in 5 days. Enrol now for practical drafting tools.
lede: Effective board paper writing turns operational, financial, and risk information into concise papers that support governance decisions. For professionals preparing or reviewing board, committee, and executive submissions, the course develops practical skills in structuring decision-focused summaries, mapping evidence to recommendations, framing risks and options, and managing review workflows and follow-up actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare or review board papers, executive briefs, and committee submissions in governance-heavy environments.
prerequisites: No advanced writing qualification is required, but you should have working experience preparing reports, memos, presentations, or committee papers in a corporate environment. You will benefit most if you already support senior leaders, contribute to governance packs, or handle review cycles across finance, risk, operations, or legal functions. Please bring examples of existing reports, board papers, or draft recommendations for practical exercises. A laptop is recommended for drafting and revision exercises. No coding or programming is required. The course introduces digital drafting and review workflows at an operational application level, not a technical engineering level.
